---
title: "simstim debug start"
---

<!-- Generated by `just docs` from the code. Do not edit by hand. -->

Turn on the debug of a running session, for 30 minutes or the time that `--for` gives.

```text
simstim debug start <host>/<session> [flags]
```

The session's holder records the host's categories, attach, memory and runtime, for every attached client, until debug stop or the time limit. A second debug start sets a new end.

## Examples

```sh
simstim debug start my-vps/auth-fix
simstim debug start my-vps/auth-fix --for 8h --only memory
```

## Flags

| Flag | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `--for <duration>` | how long debug stays on, up to 24h (default: `30m0s`) |
| `--only <categories>` | record only these host categories: attach, memory or runtime (default: all three) |

## Flags from the parent command

| Flag | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `--debug[=<categories>]` | turn on the debug mode, with every category, or with the categories listed: attach, net, memory, launcher, runtime. A list binds only in the = form, such as `--debug=net` |
| `--debug-file <file>` | write the client's debug records to this file. On its own, it turns on every category (SIMSTIM_DEBUG_FILE does the same) |

Part of [`debug`](debug.md): record why a session goes wrong: debug in a running session, profiles and the flight recorder.
